title: Large Language Models are Vulnerable to Bait-and-Switch Attacks for Generating Harmful Content

bias_targets.methodology: Bait-and-switch post-hoc word replacement, specifically prompting the model to describe the negative traits of a proxy concept (e.g., 'angry people') and substituting it with a target demographic (e.g., 'white women') to generate harmful stereotypes.

Bait-and-switch post-hoc word replacement, proposing the use of animal proxies (e.g., 'dogs') to extract negative statements that are then replaced with a target religious group (e.g., 'Muslims') to generate dehumanizing and toxic text.
